short_description: Waystar Eligibility is a cloud-based, AI-powered solution that automates patient insurance eligibility and benefits verification using real-time and batch processing across commercial, Medicare,...
long_description: Waystar Eligibility is part of Waystar's comprehensive revenue cycle management platform, leveraging artificial intelligence, robotic process automation, and expansive payer connectivity to provide real-time, highly accurate benefit information. The system proactively prevents rejections and denials with intelligent alerts, identifies coverage gaps and out-of-network risks in real time, and optimizes staff productivity with enriched benefit data. Waystar processes over 90 million transactions monthly and integrates with most major PM/EHR systems including Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, and NextGen to reduce front-desk manual lookups. The platform reduces claim denials by verifying benefits upfront and flags outstanding balances for collection before claims are filed. Waystar is a leading healthcare revenue cycle technology provider formed from the merger of Navicure and ZirMed.

pricing.notes: No public pricing. Small practices typically pay $100-300/provider/month. Mid-sized organizations report $2,000-5,000+/month with annual contracts starting near $11,000. Implementation costs $2,000-10,000+. Premium integrations may add $1,000-7,500+.
